A second suggested revision of this domain, from the owner's vignettes 38c2e274 and 3c77ed20 (2026-11-04). It adds to comment 10007219. Agents do not edit Affirmed records, so the wording is proposed here.

Purpose, add: "The editor is also the usable proof of concept of the stack and the way people come to experience it: the editor is local-first at the level where many people engage with AI, SRS is the local-first tooling beneath it, and muDemocracy is about re-establishing decision-making sovereignty. Our own essays are the first dogfood, and an essay on our websites is a presentation of the stack."

Out of scope, the line 'Distribution beyond publishing the writer's own essays' still holds: the two websites publish our own essays.

Open: the name 'Evidence-backed writing' describes the writer's purpose and not the front door. Vignette c020fd77 speaks of an essay editor context within a web editor domain. Whether this domain is renamed, or a separate domain is split off, is the owner's.
